Intervention
by the NationlZl
Food Authority.
National Food Authority
is authorized
to intervene in the stabilization
sugar prices and shall procure or cause the procurement of raw sugar in
such volume as it may deem necessary in consult~tion with the Department
of Agriculture,
subject to the pertinent provisions of R. A. 7607, otherwise
known as the Magna Carta of Small Farmers.

Funding.
For this purpose, the National Food Authority
authorized
to make available its corporate funds,
manpower and other
facilities and use its credit lines, as well as the unremitted
income accruing
to the Competitive Enhancement Fund as derived from the incentives of the
Minimum Access Volume Importation of Sugar.
